description: Update frequency metadata for each dataset. Describes how often the source data is expected to change. Does not verify actual schedules or contact any external services.

railway_zones.notes: Railway zones change very rarely. Treated as static reference data.

railway_divisions.notes: Railway divisions change very rarely. Treated as static reference data.

station_codes.notes: Station codes may be added or retired periodically.

station_master.notes: Station master records may receive updates with new stations or metadata changes.

train_master.notes: Train schedules change with timetable revisions, typically quarterly.

station_categories.notes: Station categories are a stable classification, rarely updated.

station_status.notes: Station operational status may change due to construction, closures, or reopenings.
